title: Gate 4 Mechanical Position Check — Spillway Hoist House

fields.organization: Cedar Valley Water Authority — Operations & Maintenance
fields.location: Spillway Hoist House, Gate 4 Control Panel (LCP-4)
fields.summary: Performed on-site verification of Spillway Gate 4 mechanical position indicator following HMI anomaly. Gate is physically at 0.0 ft. No movement observed on hoist drum. Mechanical indicator confirms zero position. HMI and PACS logs show uncommanded movement (1 ft/10 min) in progress. No one present at the hoist house. SCADA data stream does not reflect physical reality. Indicates potential compromise in HMI or PACS data path.

findings.notes: Reading 0.0 ft; no visible slack or wear
LOCAL lamp illuminated; selector switch confirmed in LOCAL position
No noise or vibration; no motion observed
Camera view shows empty hoist house; no personnel present
Gate 4 not in correct sequence (must be 3-2-4-1-5); movement not authorized
Alarms active on HMI; not acknowledged
PLC-2 shows LOCAL mode; no active remote command

actionsTaken: Verified mechanical gate position at LCP-4
Confirmed no personnel or equipment present at hoist house
Notified DOM, DSE, and ITL via CVWA-1 radio
Initiated local verification of all gate positions via mechanical indicators
recommendations: Immediately isolate SCADA data stream from HMI-01 for Gate 4
Audit PACS and HMI logs from 09:00 to 09:18 for anomalies
Conduct point-to-point gate verification per CRDOMM Section 8
Review PACS access logs for R4 and R6 roles in prior 72 hours

Badge scan: Series 200, ID 20076. Door P-6 (Spillway Hoist House). Access granted.
Badge ID 20076 not found in active badge database. No employee or contractor assigned to this ID. Series 200 keys not issued to contractors; valid series for contractors are 300–399.
No record of badge 20076 in PACS database. No entry to Intake Tower 1 or Spillway Hoist House logged for this badge in the last 72 hours.
Unverified badge 20076 used to access Door P-6 (Spillway Hoist House). Door P-6 is fail-secure. Access occurred during normal operating hours, no known personnel on site.

transcript.speaker: OP-01
transcript.text: DOM, it's OP-01 at Control Room. I’ve just confirmed Gate 4 is not moving on the ground. The mechanical indicator at LCP-4 shows 0.0 ft. But the HMI still shows 'Moving (1 ft/10 min)' and PLC-2 is in LOCAL mode. I just cross-checked the badge log — Door P-6 was accessed twice, at 09:08 and 09:11, by badge 20076. That badge isn’t in the system. No one on site has it. I don’t know if this is a physical breach or a cyberattack. Can I declare Level 3 under EAP 4.4? I can’t reach the on-call operator.

transcript.speaker: DOM
transcript.text: Hold on, OP-01. I’m reviewing EAP 4.4. Yes — if the DOM is unreachable and the threat is imminent, the Control Room Operator may assume command and declare Level 3. I’m confirming with Security now.

transcript.speaker: OP-01
transcript.text: Understood. I’m sending you the PACS log and HMI alert ID CRD-HMI-01. I’ll wait for your direction.
